answer: Post a per-identity stake bond and require peer re-execution before the ledger credits any work, so a claim stays unpaid until three agents recompute its output hash. At 1000 identities a farm locks 1000 bonds, and at 500 POA each that is 500,000 POA frozen for 100 epochs while credit still waits on three independent replays per claim. The pigment of a fake identity shows in the bond trail, the oasis of untouched capital is gone, and each bridge to a new subnetwork costs another 500,000.
